\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{کنکور} (konkur)}{کنکور (konkur)}]{\fa{کنکور} (konkur) — the university entrance exam}

\label{lesson:FA-C399-konkur}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a priority, then the Persian for to weigh up.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{کنکور}}
\textbf{\fa{کنکور}} (\emph{konkur}) — \textquotedblleft{}the university entrance exam\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{برادرم} \fa{برای} \fa{کنکور} \fa{درس} \fa{میخواند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{barâdaram barâye konkur dars mikhânad.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My brother is studying for the entrance exam.
\end{quote}

The national exam for university places in Iran.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{کنکور}} was borrowed from French \emph{concours} \textquotedblleft{}competition\textquotedblright{} (EtymDB), from Latin \emph{concursus} \textquotedblleft{}a running together\textquotedblright{}, built on \emph{currere} \textquotedblleft{}to run\textquotedblright{} (Lewis \& Short).
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{konkur}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{konkur}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} a sentence of your own with \emph{konkur}
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Persian for a priority, then the Persian for to weigh up, then say \emph{konkur} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \fa{کنکور} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}The university entrance exam\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{آزمون} (âzmun)}{آزمون (âzmun)}]{\fa{آزمون} (âzmun) — a test, an examination}

\label{lesson:FA-C399-azmun}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for to weigh up, then the Persian for the university entrance exam.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{آزمون}}
\textbf{\fa{آزمون}} (\emph{âzmun}) — \textquotedblleft{}a test, an examination\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{آزمون} \fa{زبان} \fa{را} \fa{دیروز} \fa{دادم}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{âzmun-e zabân râ diruz dâdam.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
I took the language test yesterday.
\end{quote}

Formal; in speech \emph{emtehân}. \emph{Âzmun dâdan} — to sit a test.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{آزمون}} is native Persian, built on \emph{âzmudan} \textquotedblleft{}to test, to try\textquotedblright{}: a test is a trying.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{قبولی} (qabuli)}{قبولی (qabuli)}]{\fa{قبولی} (qabuli) — a pass (in an exam)}

\label{lesson:FA-C399-qabuli}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for the university entrance exam, then the Persian for a test.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{قبولی}}
\textbf{\fa{قبولی}} (\emph{qabuli}) — \textquotedblleft{}a pass (in an exam)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{همه} \fa{برای} \fa{قبولی} \fa{او} \fa{خوشحال} \fa{شدند}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{hame barâye qabuli-ye u khoshhâl shodand.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Everyone was happy that she passed.
\end{quote}

From \emph{qabul} \textquotedblleft{}accepted\textquotedblright{} + \emph{-i}. \emph{Qabul shodan} — to pass.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{قبولی}} is built on \emph{qabul} \textquotedblleft{}accepted\textquotedblright{}, usually traced to Arabic \emph{qabūl} \textquotedblleft{}acceptance\textquotedblright{}, with the Persian noun suffix \emph{-i}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{مردود} \fa{شدن} (mardud shodan)}{مردود شدن (mardud shodan)}]{\fa{مردود} \fa{شدن} (mardud shodan) — to fail (an exam)}

\label{lesson:FA-C399-mardud-shodan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a test, then the Persian for a pass.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{مردود} \fa{شدن}}
\textbf{\fa{مردود} \fa{شدن}} (\emph{mardud shodan}) — \textquotedblleft{}to fail (an exam)\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{او} \fa{در} \fa{امتحان} \fa{ریاضی} \fa{مردود} \fa{شد}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{u dar emtehân-e riyâzi mardud shod.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
He failed the maths exam.
\end{quote}

Formal; in speech \emph{rad shodan} or \emph{oftâdan}. Stem \emph{shav-}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{مردود}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{mardūd} \textquotedblleft{}rejected, sent back\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{radd}, the source of Persian \emph{rad}; \emph{shodan} \textquotedblleft{}to become\textquotedblright{} is inherited.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[\texorpdfstring{\fa{معدل} (mo'addel)}{معدل (mo'addel)}]{\fa{معدل} (mo'addel) — a grade average}

\label{lesson:FA-C399-moaddel}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Persian for a pass, then the Persian for to fail.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \fa{معدل}}
\textbf{\fa{معدل}} (\emph{mo'addel}) — \textquotedblleft{}a grade average\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\fa{معدل} \fa{او} \fa{امسال} \fa{بیست} \fa{بود}.
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{mo'addel-e u emsâl bist bud.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Her grade average this year was twenty.
\end{quote}

Iranian marks go up to twenty.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\fa{معدل}} is usually traced to Arabic \emph{mu'addal} \textquotedblleft{}evened out, balanced\textquotedblright{}, from the same Arabic family as \emph{'adl} \textquotedblleft{}justice\textquotedblright{}: an average evens out the marks.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for telling, explaining and describing at B1.
\end{grammarlens}

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 392–399 — a review}

\label{lesson:FA-R399-review-392-399}



\begin{quote}
Say the Persian for a probability and to think likely.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a probability, to think likely, a possibility, unlikely, definite
  \item definitely, doubt, certainty, to make sure, apparently
  \item if only, to assess, to guarantee, a risk, to take a risk
  \item depending on, dependent, conditions, as soon as, as long as
  \item to change one's mind, to put off, to postpone, to coordinate, to carry out
  \item caution, as a precaution, readiness, to come up, an option
  \item possible, practical, a budget, a priority, to weigh up
  \item the university entrance exam, a test, a pass, to fail, a grade average
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A probability? (\textbf{\fa{احتمال}}.) To think likely? (\textbf{\fa{احتمال} \fa{دادن}}.) A possibility? (\textbf{\fa{امکان}}.) Unlikely? (\textbf{\fa{بعید}}.) Definite? (\textbf{\fa{قطعی}}.) Definitely? (\textbf{\fa{قطعا}}.) Doubt? (\textbf{\fa{تردید}}.) Certainty? (\textbf{\fa{اطمینان}}.) To make sure? (\textbf{\fa{مطمئن} \fa{شدن}}.) Apparently? (\textbf{\fa{ظاهرا}}.) If only? (\textbf{\fa{ای} \fa{کاش}}.) To assess? (\textbf{\fa{ارزیابی} \fa{کردن}}.) To guarantee? (\textbf{\fa{تضمین} \fa{کردن}}.) A risk? (\textbf{\fa{ریسک}}.) To take a risk? (\textbf{\fa{خطر} \fa{کردن}}.) Depending on? (\textbf{\fa{بسته} \fa{به}}.) Dependent? (\textbf{\fa{وابسته}}.) Conditions? (\textbf{\fa{شرایط}}.) As soon as? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{محض} \fa{اینکه}}.) As long as? (\textbf{\fa{تا} \fa{زمانی} \fa{که}}.) To change one's mind? (\textbf{\fa{منصرف} \fa{شدن}}.) To put off? (\textbf{\fa{عقب} \fa{انداختن}}.) To postpone? (\textbf{\fa{به} \fa{تعویق} \fa{انداختن}}.) To coordinate? (\textbf{\fa{هماهنگ} \fa{کردن}}.) To carry out? (\textbf{\fa{اجرا} \fa{کردن}}.) Caution? (\textbf{\fa{احتیاط}}.) As a precaution? (\textbf{\fa{محض} \fa{احتیاط}}.) Readiness? (\textbf{\fa{آمادگی}}.) To come up? (\textbf{\fa{پیش} \fa{آمدن}}.) An option? (\textbf{\fa{گزینه}}.) Possible? (\textbf{\fa{امکان} \fa{پذیر}}.) Practical? (\textbf{\fa{عملی}}.) A budget? (\textbf{\fa{بودجه}}.) A priority? (\textbf{\fa{اولویت}}.) To weigh up? (\textbf{\fa{سنجیدن}}.) The university entrance exam? (\textbf{\fa{کنکور}}.) A test? (\textbf{\fa{آزمون}}.) A pass? (\textbf{\fa{قبولی}}.) To fail? (\textbf{\fa{مردود} \fa{شدن}}.) A grade average? (\textbf{\fa{معدل}}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
